dispositions.requirement: Motor vehicles being driven upon any highway outside of a business district in a caravan or motorcade, whether or not towing other vehicles, shall be operated to allow sufficient space between each such vehicle or combination of vehicles so as to enable any other vehicle or combination of vehicles to enter and occupy such space without danger.
dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Full vehicle/combination body envelopes, entrant entry and occupancy history, independently sourced district and formation context.

dispositions.requirement: Space permits another vehicle or combination to enter and occupy without danger; preserve observations without declaring danger threshold.

dispositions.requirement: Outside-business-district highway, caravan or motorcade, with and without towing.
dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Full vehicle/combination body envelopes, entrant entry and occupancy history, independently sourced district and formation context.

measurement_plan: Full-body pair clearances and whole entrant occupancy per original sample; trailer body vertices included in each towed combination envelope.
static_checks: Connected long highway and distinct group/entrant participants
mechanisms: Equal/opposite hitch spring forces for free rolling wheeled towed vehicle; physical stability and actual towing coupling require GPU checks
limitations: Spring hitch stability, coupling, all body visibility, entry/occupancy and towing physical behavior require Native verification.
No numerical sufficient-space/danger standard; district and formation are authored context requiring legal factual review.
audits: Original full-body group/combination envelope and outsider occupancy
Tow coupling constraint residuals and stability throughout original episode
Danger and sufficient space remain separate legal judgments
